## ARK Invest buys $22.8M in Nvidia while selling AMD and Palantir positions across four ETFs

ARK's public rotation into NVDA and out of AMD/PLTR is a high-profile fund-flow signal reinforcing NVDA's perceived dominance in AI compute; PM should assess whether this reflects a durable competitive-moat conviction or tactical rebalancing before drawing portfolio implications.

- Cathie Wood's ARK Invest purchased approximately $22.8M of NVDA shares.
- ARK simultaneously exited or reduced AMD and PLTR positions across four of its ETFs.
- The rotation signals a concentrated preference for NVDA within ARK's AI compute allocation.
- No valuation rationale or price targets are cited in coverage from either outlet.
